subject: Clarify portal credentialing, MSA redline, and signer routing
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@medisphere.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor enrollment questions + Order Form redlines

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Per our discussion, I’m sending the draft order form with the minimal redlines we proposed (attached) and our standard vendor onboarding checklist so your ProcureOps team can confirm required fields in Ariba/Coupa. Two quick asks to help us avoid a second legal loop: 

1) Who will execute on behalf of Medisphere (title/role)? Does your process require an officer-level signature or is delegated signing accepted for vendor agreements under $250k?

2) For enrollment in Ariba we’ll need the KYC evidence you require (W-9/POC for US, VAT forms for EU). I attached a sample KYC template — can you confirm which fields ProcureOps needs populated to create the vendor record?

Attachments: Proposed_Order_Form_Redlines.docx (docx), Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (pdf), Medisphere_KYC_Template.xlsx (xlsx)

If you prefer, happy to jump on a 20-min screen share this week to step through the required portal fields.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@medisphere.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@medisphere.com>, Sally Turner <sally.turner@medisphere.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment questions + Order Form redlines

Thanks Aditya — looping in ProcureOps and our counsel Sally so we have the right folks. A few clarifications: 

- Execution: For commercial vendor agreements we require an officer signature only if the total committed spend exceeds $500k. For smaller contracts we accept delegated signatures from Procurement Directors provided we have a signed signature authority matrix on file. I’ll confirm the current delegate for this deal.

- Ariba fields: ProcureOps says they need a legal entity name, tax ID, remit address, primary AP contact, and an invoice notification email. They also prefer a single PO-ack email that our system can auto-ack.

- KYC: We can accept the template you provided. We will also need a copy of Redwood’s SOC 2 or equivalent security attestation for vendor risk intake — is that available?

Can you confirm whether the MSA redlines in the doc are intended to be upstream changes to the MSA or limited to order-form level terms? That will help Sally triage.

Oliver
Senior Manager, Procurement — Medisphere Health
oliver.chen@medisphere.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@medisphere.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Vendor enrollment questions + Order Form redlines — legal help requested

Marissa / Kimberly — could you take a quick look below? Medisphere flagged two things that may affect onboarding cadence: (1) they want to know whether redlines require MSA-level changes vs order-form only, and (2) they need our SOC 2 (or equivalent) for KYC.

My read: the attached doc highlights liability & indemnity clarifications and a 90-day data deletion note — those could be MSA amendments if they insist, but we should push to absorb as order-form addenda where possible to avoid lengthy procurement signoffs. If we can provide a current security attestation (SOC2 Type II) and a short evidence bundle, that should satisfy their vendor intake for now.

Suggested ask for legal: quick position on whether we can accept a one-off order-form amendment (preferred) and prepare a one-page evidence bundle (SOC2 cert, data retention statement, contact for security review). If that’s doable, I’ll coordinate ProcureOps mapping and schedule a 30-min sign-off call.

Thanks — Aditya

From: Sally Turner <sally.turner@medisphere.com>
To: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@medisphere.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@medisphere.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment questions + Order Form redlines

Hi all — I reviewed the redlines. A couple of notes from legal counsel: 

1) Execution authority: Medisphere’s signatory policy requires officer-level execution only for new MSAs where the indemnity or liability exposure changes materially. From a practical perspective, if Redwood is willing to limit the rewritten clauses to the order form (i.e., no MSA text updated), we can approach our Procurement Director for delegated execution. That will shave 2–3 weeks off the timeline.

2) SOC2/evidence: Please upload a current SOC2 Type II report or, if you cannot provide the full report, we accept an SOC2 attestation letter plus the security contact and a short data retention statement. We will also require the KYC fields as Oliver listed.

3) DocuSign: For speed, I’ll send a DocuSign envelope that includes a one-page order-form amendment (if you accept that path). If Redwood agrees, we can avoid redline-ing the baseline MSA. DocuSign link (test envelope): https://www.docusign.com/txn/example-sign-link/abc123

Please confirm whether you accept order-form amendment only, and then I’ll route the envelope to our Procurement Director for delegated signature.

—Sally
Sally Turner
Deputy General Counsel — Medisphere Health
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@medisphere.com>, Sally Turner <sally.turner@medisphere.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment questions + Order Form redlines — next steps and calendar

Thanks Sally — we can accept the order-form amendment approach to keep the MSA unchanged. Kimberly, can you draft a short order-form amendment (one page) that captures the redlined liability clarification and the 90-day deletion note Sally referenced? If you can, we’ll route back immediately for DocuSign.

Oliver — I’ll attach the SOC2 attestation and a two-page evidence bundle for ProcureOps to ingest into Ariba. I’ll also populate the KYC template and return it by EOD Monday.

Proposed next steps: 
- Kimberly: draft one-page amendment (target: Tue EOD)
- Aditya: upload SOC2 attestation + evidence bundle and completed KYC (target: Mon EOD)
- Oliver/Sally: confirm delegated signatory (Procurement Director) so DocuSign envelope can be routed (target: Tue AM)

I booked a 30-min slot to align on Tuesday 31 May at 10:00 AM PT — calendar invite here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=onboarding-align-20270531 (please accept if the time works).

Attachments to follow in separate email: SOC2_Attestation.pdf, Onboarding_Evidence_Bundle.zip, Completed_KYC.xlsx

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this approach should get Medisphere fully enrolled in Ariba and enable PO routing within the week once the DocuSign envelope is signed.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
